senses.gloss: नहि na-hí, not to be sure, certainly not: 🞄nahi-yatas, because not — therefore.

नहुष náh-uṣ-a, m. [connexion], descent, 🞄race;
 N., esp. of a king who displaced Indra, 🞄but was after wards transformed into a serpent.

नाहुष 1. nā́huṣa, a. (ī) akin;
 m. kinsman.
नाहुष 2. nāhuṣa, m. descendant of Nahuṣa, 🞄pat. of Yayāti.
